title: Fixed-width tape block
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input symbols, let $u$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $j$ be a natural number. The block at position $j$ is the length-$W(N)$ segment of $u$ beginning at index $W(N)j$, truncated if $u$ ends before the segment is complete.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols
